name: Transfer of Funds Regulation
impact_assessment: SWD(2021) 190 (joint impact assessment for the 2021 AML package; executive summary SWD(2021) 191)
evidence_rating: ex-ante only: applies since December 2024; no evaluation yet
summary: The Regulation extends the 'travel rule' (information on sender and recipient) to crypto-asset transfers from 30 December 2024; EBA guidelines apply from the same date. No evaluation or study of its effect on money laundering exists yet; the impact assessment covered the whole anti-money-laundering package and did not quantify the effect of this Regulation.

literature.citation: European Commission (2021), Impact Assessment accompanying the anti-money laundering package (executive summary), SWD(2021) 191 (full IA SWD(2021) 190)
literature.title: Impact Assessment accompanying the anti-money laundering package (executive summary)
literature.headline: Package-level assessment: harmonised rules, an EU supervisor and a EUR 10,000 cash limit; 99% of 202 consultation replies saw a need for further action; no separate quantification for transfers of funds
literature.summary_plain: The Commission's assessment of the anti-money-laundering package expected stronger, more uniform rules, but did not estimate the effect of the transfer-information rules on their own.
